questions.q: Which four observable planes must autonomous threat detection instrument simultaneously?
options: Authentication/session, query execution, privilege/schema mutation, and data volume
questions.explain: A single anomalous signal is noise; only when signals correlate across planes — e.g. unusual hour plus novel query plus high row volume — does it become a conclusive incident.

questions.q: The session scoring loop uses two composite-score thresholds. What are they, and what does each trigger?
options: WARN at 2.5 (alert to SIEM/on-call) and ACT at 4.0 (autonomous containment)
WARN at 4.0 and ACT at 2.5, in reverse order
questions.explain: The composite weights rows at 0.40, time at 0.25, exec time at 0.20, and novelty at 0.15; the ACT threshold is tuned upward in shadow mode until false positives drop below one per week.

questions.q: A session scores 6.2 on the composite threat scale. Which containment level applies?
options: Level 4: revoke the login and capture forensics
questions.explain: The graduated ladder is 4.0-5.5 rate-limit, 5.5-7.0 terminate the query, above 7.0 terminate the session; two Level-2 terminations in 5 minutes auto-escalate to Level 3.

questions.q: Before Level 3/4 autonomous actions, the containment engine runs a quorum check. What does it verify?
options: Whether the DDL change window is open
That the target user accounts for no more than 60% of active sessions; otherwise the action is suppressed and escalated to a human queue
questions.explain: The quorum check prevents a miscalibrated score from causing an application outage by killing the majority of its connections; protected principals (monitor, backup agents, DBA accounts) are excluded entirely.

questions.q: How does the chapter treat DDL and privilege changes occurring outside the sanctioned change window (Saturday 02:00-04:00 UTC)?
options: As unconditional high-severity signals that bypass the statistical scoring model entirely, captured by a server-scoped DDL trigger
As normal behavior to be scored by the model
As low-priority noise to be filtered out
questions.explain: Schema mutations and grants don't need statistical modeling — any DDL outside the change window is an unconditional signal, captured synchronously by the DDL trigger for sub-second detection.
